name: Naemateliaceae

children.name: Naematelia
children.description: Naematelia — a genus of naemateliaceae in the family Naemateliaceae.

children.name: Naematelia aurantia
children.description: Naematelia aurantia (synonym Tremella aurantia) is a species of fungus producing yellow, frondose, gelatinous basidiocarps (fruit bodies).

children.name: Naematelia aurantialba
children.description: Naematelia aurantialba (synonym Tremella aurantialba) is a species of fungus producing yellow, frondose, gelatinous basidiocarps (fruit bodies) parasitic on fruit bodies of another fungus, Stereum hirsutum, on broadleaf trees.

children.name: Naematelia encephala
children.description: Naematelia encephala (synonym Tremella encephala) is a species of fungus producing pink, brain-like, gelatinous basidiocarps (fruit bodies).

children.name: Dimennazyma
children.description: Dimennazyma — a genus of naemateliaceae in the family Naemateliaceae.
